req_spec.title: Storage recovery, navigation and accessibility
req_spec.scope: Derived acceptance requirements supplementing README.md TF-REQ-001..019. Member E scope uses src/utils/storage.js, normalization/validation helpers, StorageBanner.jsx, Sidebar.jsx, TopBar.jsx, Toast.jsx, Modal.jsx, App.jsx and App.css. Code-derived requirements below do not claim original TF-REQ identifiers.

requirement.title: Reload persistence
requirement.description: A valid task array is loaded at app initialization and remains visible after ordinary reload. Code-derived. Sources: README.md (Storage / Behaviour notes / Exact messages); src/utils/storage.js loadTasks; src/App.jsx useState(loadTasks); baseline main@5133a6c.

requirement.title: Missing and corrupt storage
requirement.description: A missing key loads empty without warning. Malformed JSON or parsed non-array loads empty, backs up original raw string byte-for-byte under taskflow_tasks_backup, and shows exact corruption warning with Reset storage. Sources: README.md (Storage / Behaviour notes / Exact messages); src/utils/storage.js loadTasks/keepBackup; baseline main@5133a6c.

requirement.title: Invalid entries and duplicate ids
requirement.description: Skip entries with missing/empty/non-string id, invalid validateTask values, unparseable/missing createdAt, or duplicate id after first valid occurrence. Keep valid entries in order. Back up original array JSON and show exact count: 1 saved entry was invalid and skipped. A backup was kept. or N saved entries were invalid and skipped. A backup was kept. Code-derived. Sources: README.md (Storage / Behaviour notes / Exact messages); src/utils/storage.js toSavedTask/loadTasks; src/utils/validation.js validateTask; baseline main@5133a6c.

requirement.title: Updated timestamp fallback and normalization
requirement.description: For valid entries missing or invalid updatedAt, use createdAt exactly. Retain normalized title/description; missing description and undefined/null/empty dueDate become empty strings. Code-derived. Sources: README.md (Storage / Behaviour notes / Exact messages); src/utils/storage.js toSavedTask; src/utils/tasks.js normalizeValues; baseline main@5133a6c.

requirement.title: Storage read failure
requirement.description: If localStorage.getItem throws, return empty tasks and warning Browser storage is unavailable, so tasks cannot be loaded or saved. with canReset false. Code-derived. Sources: README.md (Storage / Behaviour notes / Exact messages); src/utils/storage.js loadTasks; baseline main@5133a6c.

requirement.title: Reset and backup retention
requirement.description: Reset removes only taskflow_tasks, ignores removal failure, clears current in-memory tasks and warning, and retains taskflow_tasks_backup. Code-derived. Sources: README.md (Storage / Behaviour notes / Exact messages); src/utils/storage.js resetStorage; src/App.jsx handleResetStorage; baseline main@5133a6c.

requirement.title: Failed write remains optimistic
requirement.description: A failed save returns false; App still updates in-memory state and shows Could not save tasks to browser storage. The mutation is not persisted and can disappear after reload. Code-derived. Sources: README.md (Storage / Behaviour notes / Exact messages); src/utils/storage.js saveTasks; src/App.jsx commit/createTask/changeStatus; src/components/Toast.jsx; baseline main@5133a6c.

requirement.title: Warning announcement and dismissal
requirement.description: Storage warning renders as role=alert with supplied text and Dismiss warning button. Dismissal hides current warning without changing storage. Code-derived. Sources: README.md (Storage / Behaviour notes / Exact messages); src/components/StorageBanner.jsx; src/App.jsx warning state; baseline main@5133a6c.

requirement.title: Navigation and page title
requirement.description: Dashboard and All Tasks reset status filter to All; status navigation selects matching filter. Active nav button has aria-current=page and TopBar h1 follows active label. Code-derived; query behavior belongs to D. Sources: README.md (Storage / Behaviour notes / Exact messages); README.md Behaviour notes; src/App.jsx navigate/activeNav; src/components/Sidebar.jsx; src/components/TopBar.jsx; baseline main@5133a6c.

requirement.title: Responsive sidebar breakpoint
requirement.description: At 769px+, desktop collapse toggles width 248px/72px and hides brand/nav/profile labels. At <=768px, CSS applies a 272px off-canvas drawer and overlay. README says under 768px, while CSS includes exactly 768px; 769px is desktop. Code-derived breakpoint detail. Sources: README.md (Storage / Behaviour notes / Exact messages); README.md Behaviour notes; src/App.css @media max-width:768px and min-width:769px; src/components/Sidebar.jsx; baseline main@5133a6c.

requirement.title: Drawer close paths
requirement.description: Mobile menu opens drawer; nav selection, Close menu or overlay click closes it. Nav selection also updates filter/view and heading. Code-derived. Sources: README.md (Storage / Behaviour notes / Exact messages); src/App.jsx navigate/drawerOpen; src/components/Sidebar.jsx; src/components/TopBar.jsx; baseline main@5133a6c.

requirement.title: Dialog name, focus and opener restoration
requirement.description: Dialog has role=dialog, aria-modal=true and aria-labelledby referencing visible h2. On open focus moves to data-autofocus control; on unmount focus returns to element active when mounted. Do not assert focus trap; none is implemented. Code-derived. Sources: README.md (Storage / Behaviour notes / Exact messages); src/components/Modal.jsx; src/components/TaskFormModal.jsx; src/components/ConfirmDeleteModal.jsx; baseline main@5133a6c.

requirement.title: Toast timing and semantics
requirement.description: Toast closes after 3000ms (manual tolerance 2700–3800ms), has Dismiss notification control, role=status for success and role=alert for error. Code-derived. Sources: README.md (Storage / Behaviour notes / Exact messages); README.md Exact messages; src/components/Toast.jsx; baseline main@5133a6c.
